title: Real log: svchost opens LSASS
source: Real telemetry from OTRF Security-Datasets (MIT), lab-generated, not employer data
question: An LSASS-access rule fired on this event. True or false positive?
explanation: svchost.exe from System32 asking LSASS for 0x1000 (limited query) access is normal background behaviour; it showed up as legitimate baseline traffic before the attack began in the same capture. Confirm the image path, then allow-list it on that access mask. Dumping tools need read-memory rights such as 0x1010 or 0x1410, so alert on the access mask and the source, not on the target alone.
